name: ActionCard
description: A card that is one link: an illustration in a Media slot, a headline, and a chevron. The whole surface is the target and the headline is the accessible name. Used in the Acrobat "Get started with Acrobat tools" row (ActionCardRow).

props.name: target
props.description: Integration detail; new-window links append an accessible hint.

props.name: mediaSrc
props.description: Decorative illustration; aria-hidden. Assets: apps/storybook/stories/assets/action-card/<slug>_2x.png (+ .svg for vector art).

props.name: headline
props.description: The card's accessible name (whole card is the link). Default in Figma: "Headline".

root.description: Block-level link, 313px wide in the row. No padding on the root: the media is full-bleed (top, clipped by the card's radius) and the copy block carries its own padding. Hug height; in a row the cards stretch to the tallest. radius/lg (22px) and spacing/2xl (40px) are the tokens nearest the original 26px / 39px.

media.description: Full-bleed, top of the card, 4:3 (313×235). The illustration is content: an image fill on the Media instance, exported from the original tile cropped at the copy block's top (313×228).

copy.description: Headline and chevron on one row, start-aligned, vertically centred; the chevron hugs the text (the headline hugs its content up to the row's inner width).

headline.description: Text style s2a/typography/heading-5 (24px): the rung nearest the original 29px that keeps most headlines on one line; two-line headlines make the card 339 tall.

chevron.description: S2a_Icon_Chevron_Right at 16px; decorative, never the only indication of the link (WCAG 1.4.1).

keyboard.action: moves focus to the card as one stop

notes: One link, one accessible name: the headline text. Media, icon and chevron are aria-hidden so the name is not padded with noise.
No interactive element may be nested inside the card (a link inside a link is invalid HTML and unreachable by keyboard).
Focus ring is drawn on the whole card surface (2.4.7) and the target is at least 24×24 (2.5.8).
Headline and description meet 4.5:1 on the card surface; the chevron and any border meet 3:1 (1.4.3, 1.4.11).
The arrow is decorative: link purpose comes from the headline text (2.4.4), not from the glyph alone (1.4.1).
